name: Zerodha
description: Indian stocks, indices, futures and options (NSE, BSE, NFO, BFO, MCX, CDS) with history and live prices from your Zerodha Kite Connect app. History is kept in a bar store on this computer, or in ClickHouse.

settings.label: API key (KITE_API_KEY)
settings.help: Your Kite Connect app's API key (developers.kite.trade).

settings.label: User ID (KITE_USER_ID)
settings.help: Your Zerodha client ID, such as AB1234.

settings.label: TOTP secret (KITE_TOTP_SECRET)
settings.help: The key shown when you turned on TOTP in Kite (the text under the QR code). The plugin makes the 6-digit codes from it to log in each day.

settings.label: Always record
settings.help: Symbols whose 1-minute bars are kept in the bar store for as long as OpenTrader is open, with or without a chart: such as NSE:RELIANCE, NFO:NIFTY26NOVFUT.

settings.label: ClickHouse URL
settings.help: Leave empty to keep bars in a file on this computer. Or give a ClickHouse server, such as http://localhost:8123, to keep them there.

settings.label: ClickHouse database
settings.help: Created if it does not exist.

setup: Create a Kite Connect app at developers.kite.trade (history needs its historical data add-on) and open its login URL once in a browser to authorise it. Then fill in the KITE_* fields: the plugin logs in on its own each day and keeps the day's token in its folder. Open a symbol such as NSE:RELIANCE, NSE:NIFTY_50 or an option like NFO:NIFTY26N2424000CE. Enable either this plugin or Dhan for Indian exchanges, not both. Settings, secrets included, are kept in OpenTrader's settings on this computer.
